summary: Completed a comprehensive commercial overhaul of the B2B SaaS Landing Page (/landing) and Admin Command Center (/admin) based on the Bizfly BizChatAI and Linear/Stripe design benchmark.

landing_page_overhaul: Eliminated AI-cliché tropes (generic gradients, emoji bullets, oversized cartoon cards) in favor of Obsidian/Indigo precision theme with Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono typography.
Embedded Interactive Live Browser Shell Simulator (/landing#simulator) with real-time conversational shopping test, sizing assistance, and live lead score gauge (HOT/WARM/COLD).
Built interactive ROI & Savings Calculator with sliders for chat volume (30-1000/day), staff headcount (1-10), and Average Order Value (150k-2M VND), calculating hours saved and revenue lift.
Added 6 Omnichannel Integration Bento Grid (Website Widget, Facebook Messenger, Zalo OA, TikTok Shop, Shopee Open Platform, Lazada Open Platform).
Detailed authentic Vietnamese business case studies (Hanoi fashion boutique, HCMC footwear studio, omnichannel media agency).
Added deep-dive Vietnamese SMB FAQs covering Meta/Zalo policy compliance, data isolation under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP, setup time, and future POS/KiotViet sync.
Polished VietQR dynamic self-registration modal with copyable bank info and instant QR generation.
admin_command_center_upgrades: Banished all small cramped fonts (<12px) across dashboard tables, badges, and modals; standardized on 14.5px-15px body, 17px thread headings, and 32px KPI typography.
Upgraded Omnichannel Inbox to a spacious 380px 3-column split with high contrast and search filtering.

Engineered dynamic Context-Aware AI Copilot Action Chips that auto-detect customer intent in real-time (sizing queries, shipping queries, address/phone capture) and provide 1-click response injection into composer.
Enhanced Customer 360 sidebar with 1-click Phone Copy, real-time Lead Score gauge, and automated Order Draft Summary (product price + 25k shipping calculation) with 1-click WON closing.
highlights.test_verification: 100% of 24 E2E integration tests passing via python tests/test_ai_inbox_e2e.py.
